techParks.name: Bosch Global Software Technologies Koramangala Campus

techParks.name: SJR Cyber

techParks.name: Prestige Blue Chip
techParks.locality: Koramangala / Adugodi (Hosur Road, Dr M H Marigowda Road)

techParks.name: IBC Knowledge Park

techParks.name: Vaishnavi Tech Park
techParks.description: Three-tower (North, Central, South) campus on Sarjapur Main Road at Ambalipura; Groww's headquarters is the South Tower and ShareChat's registered office is the Smartworks-run North Tower, with Uber, Microsoft and Safran mapped by OSM.

techParks.name: Vaishnavi Tech Square
techParks.description: Office tower at Iblur on the Sarjapur Main Road side of HSR Layout; Navi Limited's headquarters (9th floor).

techParks.name: Bharat IT Park

techParks.name: Helios Business Park
techParks.description: Multi-wing office park on the Outer Ring Road service road at Kadubeesanahalli, near New Horizon College; Meesho's headquarters (Wing E) and Ninjacart's headquarters (Tower E).

techParks.name: AMR Tech Park

techParks.name: RGA Tech Park

coverageNotes: WEB SEARCH WAS UNAVAILABLE for this run (the shared per-turn WebSearch budget was exhausted after one query), so verification relied on direct fetches of company pages, Wikipedia, WeWork India, OSM extracts and the GLEIF LEI registry API (legal and headquarters addresses filed by the companies themselves, cited per record). HIGH confidence = company page or LEI record plus an OSM building/POI; MEDIUM = one such source with an approximate point (park centroid, street-level or layout-level geocode, stated in geocodeSource/evidence); LOW = registry-only or stale. NOT CONFIRMED / LEFT OUT: Cult.fit (cult.fit Limited's LEI registered office is in Chennai and no Bengaluru building could be sourced, though the company is widely described as Bengaluru-based); Jupiter (Amica Financial Technologies lists no Bengaluru office, Mumbai HQ); Observe.AI (contact page lists only Redwood City, no Indian LEI); Dunzo's working office (only the lapsed registered office, marked closed); Bounce's current Bengaluru office (its site now gives a Gurugram address; only the registry address kept, low); Kuvera's post-CRED-acquisition desk (lapsed LEI, low); Simpl (registered at a coworking desk in Gottigere, low; working office unknown); Uni Cards (coworking registration, low). Practo's new Clayworks office is placed by hand on St. John's Hospital Road (both geocoders missed it). Flipkart's 2007 Koramangala founding flat, Swiggy's former IBC Knowledge Park office, Ola's Regent Insignia and Flipkart's Mantri Commercio floors are pre-2023 moves and so are not listed as offices (Regent Insignia is kept as low because Wikipedia and OSM still show it). Byju's IBC Knowledge Park HQ is marked 'closing' on the strength of its insolvency rather than a sourced vacate notice. Prestige Blue Chip tenants are OSM mapper leads only (Synopsys, also mapped there, has demonstrably moved), and Prestige Trade Tower was left to the G13 CBD lens. Several lens companies turned out to sit outside the Koramangala-HSR-BTM corridor (Meesho, Rapido, Moneyview, Dailyhunt, Udaan, Zepto, BlackBuck, Cashfree, PhonePe on the ORR/Sarjapur stretch; Niyo, Fi, Yellow.ai in Whitefield/Mahadevapura; Licious and Unacademy in Domlur) and are included with their verified addresses for merging with the G02/G03/G04/G10 lenses. Bosch's Bidadi plant and other out-of-corridor Bosch sites were left to the automotive/industrial lens; Bengaluru headcounts are given only where a source states one (Flipkart's and Ola Electric's are company-wide figures from Wikipedia).
